name: canonify-isomorphism
description: Why REST, CLI, and MCP are three isomorphic projections of one Canon catalog — the runtime contract they all call, the envelope they all return, why they can't drift, and how to debug 'works on CLI but not REST'. Read SKILL.md first, then deep-dive on the runtime contract or connecting an MCP client.

resources.title: The runtime contract
resources.description: The five runtime entry points (invoke / get / list / navigate / sql_read) every surface calls, the REST / CLI / MCP mapping for each, REST read filters and the request body rule, the X-Catalog-Invalidate header, the opt-in NDJSON progress stream, and the principal kinds.

resources.title: MCP access and connecting Claude Desktop
resources.description: The per-org /mcp/<slug> endpoint, its three credential types (API key, session, OAuth), the OAuth discovery and token endpoints, and the quickstart for wiring Claude Desktop to an org with per-org OAuth — one org per connection, auto-refreshing revocable tokens.
